correctness.rationale: The positive-definite block mobility μ=[K,h;h^T,m] has independent Schur noise E=Θ(K−hh^T/m) and angular diffusion D_r=Θm. Between orientation-only Poisson resets the cross term integrates in Stratonovich form to (R_{φ_S}−I)a, a=−Jh/m, with X fixed at jumps. Independent exponential renewal excursions give v=E[Y]/E[S]=−D_rρa/(1+ρ) and centered diffusion E[(Y−vS)(Y−vS)^T]/(2E S). Harmonic Laplace transforms C1=ρ/(ρ+1), C2=ρ/(ρ+4) give exactly the asserted f_parallel, f_perp and the rotated Schur matrix term. Bounded regenerative remainders yield CLT and asymptotic covariance. Independent symbolic reconstruction of first two angular reward moments and length compensation exactly equals the submitted f_parallel and f_perp for every positive formal ρ. Their derivative factors and difference polynomial prove unique maximum ρ=2 (value 5/27) and unique positive axis switch root ρ³+ρ²+ρ−2=0 in the isotropic-Schur c≠0 subfamily. High-rate tensor equals ΘK, low-rate tensor tr(E)/2 I. This checks the nonstandard random-duration correction, not merely a simulation.
